leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Vue component that tracks mouse position using reactive state
Initialize a render prop function to pass mouse coordinates to child components
Apply the render prop pattern by implementing a slot-scoped alternative in Vue
Manipulate component structure to separate tracking logic from presentation
Integrate mouse tracking functionality into multiple UI components using render props
Configure a reusable MouseTracker component that accepts dynamic rendering functions
Bind mouse event listeners to update reactive position data
Render dynamic content based on real-time mouse coordinates
